channel.title: Net Sense
channel.description: Studio network monitoring for Mac, by Nathaniel Labs.

item.description:
# Net Sense 1.0.0
The corrected first native release. A real Mac app — no Chrome, no Chromium, nothing to install alongside it.
- Reads the real ER7212PC controller, including the verified ACT/WAN3 and Jio/WAN4 field shapes. - **Verdict** — grades each internet line only after an isolated policy-routed test verifies the expected provider ASN. - **Airspace** — reads the Wi-Fi around you: who is on which channel, how crowded the air is, and where to move. - **Devices** now preserves wall-plate Ethernet ports instead of pretending every wired client is directly attached to the router. - **Coverage** is explicitly an unmeasured sketch until real walk-through points are recorded. - Finds your router by itself; asks for the controller login once and keeps it in the Mac's Keychain. - Opens on any phone or tablet on the same network for viewing. - Native sessions clear stale service-worker assets so an older web bundle cannot survive an app update.
